help.floatingDialogHint: What this page is for and the recommended steps.
help.noPageHelp: No quick guide for this page yet — try the full help panel.
help.pages.analysis.field.document: QA specification with test case tables — upload as a file or fetch from Jira / Confluence.
help.pages.analysis.field.project: Baseline source used for document-vs-code comparison.
help.pages.analysis.fields:
Project|Baseline source to compare against
Specification document|Quality assurance specification text
Comparison reference ID|Reference number for triggering a run after a decision
help.pages.analysis.steps:
Select a project for comparison context.
Upload a spec file (.md, .txt) or fetch from Jira / Confluence.
Run spec vs code comparison and read the suggested check steps.
If aligned, continue to test case generation; if differences exist, send the fix list to the development team.
help.pages.analysis.summary: Compares your written specification with the baseline derived from code. The result tells you which step to take next in the test process.
help.pages.analysis.title: Spec vs Code Comparison
help.pages.analysisDocs.fields:
Project|Application whose analysis you view
Version|Saved snapshot of the code scan
Export|Markdown or PDF download in your portal language
help.pages.analysisDocs.steps:
Select the project and connected repository.
Review the operator summary: version changes, field mismatches, and critical flows.
Download PDF or Markdown for stakeholders in your selected language.
If module spec is not release-ready, fix quality gaps before external sharing.
help.pages.analysisDocs.summary: Readable analysis from your code scan — version history, gaps, and exports in your language.
help.pages.analysisDocs.title: Analysis documents
help.pages.bi.steps:
Configure the company database connection first.
Learn schema, then open the schema explorer for easy links and column details.
Ask questions in chat — for example monthly sales or top products.
You can schedule report emails for a specific time via chat.
help.pages.bi.summary: Dynamic analytics dashboard over your company data. Ask in chat; charts and tables update instantly.
help.pages.bi.title: Business Intelligence
help.pages.biAlerts.steps:
Prefer Create with AI — pick an example chip (sales, stock, overdue invoices) and the assistant drafts the rule.
Or create manually: title, threshold comparison, and recipient email. SQL and column stay under Advanced (optional).
After save, the page explains who is notified, how often the rule is checked, and how email is sent.
Use Check alerts now to evaluate all active rules immediately. Pause or resume without deleting.
help.pages.biAlerts.summary: Email when a business metric crosses the limit you set. Start with AI; technical SQL is optional.
help.pages.biAlerts.title: Threshold alerts
help.pages.biAnalytics.steps:
Ask in plain language: list dashboards, create a chart, show a board, or delete a chart.
Pick a board from the sidebar or let the assistant open one for you.
The interface language follows your portal language setting.
help.pages.biAnalytics.summary: Create, list, view, and delete dashboards, charts, and datasets via chat.
help.pages.biAnalytics.title: AI-powered analytics
help.pages.biAudit.steps:
Review recent entries for compliance.
Failed rows show error details.
Retention period is set by your administrator.
help.pages.biAudit.summary: Read-only log of data queries, exports, and chat actions.
help.pages.biAudit.title: Reports audit log
help.pages.biBudget.fields:
Fiscal year|Year filter for envelopes and board pack
Scenario|base / optimistic / pessimistic — export and share follow this filter
Reporting currency|FX conversion for mixed-currency totals; missing rates exclude lines
Cost center|Hierarchy code; rollup includes descendants
Monthly periods|A1–A12 plan split per envelope
Commitments|PO/contract lines; release or cancel updates committed total
Lock / Close|Locked or Closed blocks amount, period, and commitment edits
Board pack|PDF/Excel and share link use current scenario and reporting currency
help.pages.biBudget.steps:
Create an envelope (OPEX/CAPEX) or download the Excel template (lines + monthly + commitments) and upload.
Set scenario and optional reporting currency so KPIs match what you export.
Paste read-only actuals SQL (or pick a schema template), then Refresh actuals.
Use Transfer to move plan amount between lines; Lock or set Closed when the plan is final.
Download board pack PDF/Excel or share a read-only pack link for stakeholders.
help.pages.biBudget.summary: Fiscal envelopes with live actuals from your company DB, FX-aware totals, monthly periods, commitments, cost-center rollup, and board-pack export — in your portal language.
help.pages.biBudget.title: Budget tracking
help.pages.biChat.steps:
Pick a session from the sidebar or start a new one.
Ask in plain language — the linked dashboard updates.
Use voice input on supported browsers.
help.pages.biChat.summary: Analyst mode with session history, streaming replies, and voice input.
help.pages.biChat.title: Full-screen reports chat
help.pages.biConnection.fields:
Deployment|On-premise or cloud environment
Connection type|Enterprise or cloud database
Access key|Key from your cloud admin panel
help.pages.biConnection.steps:
Pick a preset or enter host, port, and database details.
Test the connection — it must succeed before save.
Save and activate — then open the schema explorer to review tables and links.
help.pages.biConnection.summary: Configure enterprise or cloud databases. Credentials are stored on the server only.
help.pages.biConnection.title: Database Connection
help.pages.biGlossary.steps:
Click Add term; enter table, optional column, business name, and definition.
Edit existing rows from the actions column.
Terms are sent to the assistant as context on every chat request.
help.pages.biGlossary.summary: Map table and column names to business terms so the assistant produces accurate queries.
help.pages.biGlossary.title: Business glossary
help.pages.biQueries.steps:
Save queries from chat or the widget menu.
Click Run to preview results.
Pin to dashboard adds a table widget to the active board.
Export downloads the results.
help.pages.biQueries.summary: Queries saved from chat or widgets — re-run, export, or pin to a dashboard.
help.pages.biQueries.title: Saved queries
help.pages.biReports.steps:
Create a report from chat: "save this as weekly sales report".
Open a report to view its widgets.
Delete outdated reports from the actions column.
help.pages.biReports.summary: Saved custom report layouts created from chat.
help.pages.biReports.title: AI Reports
help.pages.biSchedules.steps:
Create schedules from chat: "send me an email tomorrow morning".
The server sends due emails on a regular schedule.
Use Send due emails now for a manual trigger.
help.pages.biSchedules.summary: Report emails sent automatically at the time you specify.
help.pages.biSchedules.title: Email Schedules
help.pages.biSchema.fields:
Easy links|Plain cards showing how tables reference each other
Tables & columns|Column order, data types, and PK/FK markers
Recent operations|Latest query and schema actions from the audit log
Technical graph|Engineer ER diagram with pan and zoom
help.pages.biSchema.steps:
Click Learn schema after the database connection is configured.
Open Easy links to see how tables connect in plain cards.
Expand Tables & columns for data types and order.
Re-run when the production schema changes.
help.pages.biSchema.summary: Tables, columns, and relationships from your database — easy link cards for operators and a technical ER graph for engineers.
help.pages.biSchema.title: Database Schema
help.pages.biShares.steps:
Create a share for the active dashboard.
Copy the internal link — it expires after the set period.
Revoke links from the table when no longer needed.
help.pages.biShares.summary: Time-limited read-only links for colleagues and management inside your company.
help.pages.biShares.title: Team dashboard sharing
help.pages.biSettings.steps:
Review LLM occupancy if the runner is connected.
Update NanobaseAI branding shown on BI surfaces.
Steward semantic terms and allowed tables for safer SQL generation.
help.pages.biSettings.summary: Branding, semantic stewardship, and LLM occupancy for the AI Reports module.
help.pages.biSettings.title: AI Reports settings
help.pages.biTemplates.steps:
Browse suggested questions for the active data source, or create your own (name + question; SQL optional).
Ask in chat sends the prompt to the BI assistant.
Select one or more templates with SQL and Add to dashboard to pin widgets on the active board (or a new board).
CEO / CFO / Sales Ops buttons create a role board from matching tables in your schema.
help.pages.biTemplates.summary: Ready-to-use questions and dashboard widgets from your live schema — create, multi-select, and pin to analytics.
help.pages.biTemplates.title: Query templates
help.pages.dashboard.steps:
Check that system, site, and service connections are green in the top bar.
Review test cases awaiting approval — P0 cases can block a test run.
Click the arrow next to the latest test run to open details.
Inspect failed tests in the Recent failures section.
help.pages.dashboard.summary: Live overview of your test process: catalog size, pending approvals, queued jobs, recent runs, and failures.
help.pages.dashboard.title: Dashboard
help.pages.enterprise.steps:
Review integrations status — Jira, Vault, MinIO, and queue health.
Configure release gates and scheduled reports per project.
Use audit and compliance tabs before customer demos.
help.pages.enterprise.summary: Enterprise controls: integrations, vault secrets, compliance exports, and platform operations.
help.pages.enterprise.title: Enterprise hub
help.pages.environment.field.api_base_ur: Base address for backend service integration tests.
help.pages.environment.field.credentials: Test account email and password. Password is stored on the server only.
help.pages.environment.field.login_path: Login page path appended to the site address.
help.pages.environment.field.project: Links this environment session to the selected project.
help.pages.environment.field.web_base_ur: Site address opened for interface tests.
help.pages.environment.fields:
Project|Links environment to a registered project
Env preset|Pre-configured address pair
Site address|Address opened for interface tests
Service address|Address for backend integration tests
Login path|Path to the login page
Email / Password|Test account — password stored on server only
help.pages.environment.steps:
Select a project — addresses auto-fill from the registry.
Pick a preset if staging or production is configured.
Enter test email and password.
Save, run a health check, then start the test process.
help.pages.environment.summary: Active test session: target addresses, login path, and test credentials. All automated tests use these values.
help.pages.environment.title: Environment Configuration
help.pages.home.steps:
Click a module card — BI reports, test automation, or NanobaseAI - Legal.
Each module opens its own workspace.
Return here anytime via the logo in the sidebar.
help.pages.home.summary: Choose AI reports (BI), test automation, or NanobaseAI - Legal — no login required on this screen.
help.pages.home.title: Home hub
help.pages.jobDetail.field.screenshot: Screen captures from failed steps or visual comparison runs.
help.pages.jobDetail.field.trace: Debug archive — open in the detailed record viewer or download.
help.pages.jobDetail.fields:
Record|Detailed run record for debugging
Screenshot|Failure or step capture
Visual diff|Pixel difference vs approved baseline
Log|Runner log output
help.pages.jobDetail.steps:
Open from the run list via the job link.
Download and inspect the detailed record file.
Review visual diffs; approve the baseline in Test Catalog if the UI change was intentional.
Check the accessibility violations table if scanning was enabled.
help.pages.jobDetail.summary: Single test job: status, browser, self-healing, artifacts, accessibility violations, and log.
help.pages.jobDetail.title: Job detail
help.pages.login.steps:
Enter your email and password.
Pick your portal language from the header if needed.
After sign-in, open the Test or BI module from the home hub.
help.pages.login.summary: Portal access with role-based permissions for QA, admin, or developer workflows.
help.pages.login.title: Sign in
help.pages.process.steps:
Complete project and environment setup first.
Run a code scan and review analysis documents.
Reconcile spec vs code and approve P0 scenarios in the catalog.
Generate and run tests, then review results and reports.
help.pages.process.summary: Code scan, reconciliation, catalog approval, generation, and execution — follow the steps in order.
help.pages.process.title: Test process hub
help.pages.projects.field.api_base_url: Optional service address when service tests are enabled.
help.pages.projects.field.app_id: Required for mobile apps — application package identifier.
help.pages.projects.field.app_name: Readable app name passed to analysis and test generation.
help.pages.projects.field.base_url: Default target for interface tests. Overridden by the environment session.
help.pages.projects.field.clone_url: Code repository address. Latest code is pulled on each run.
help.pages.projects.field.label: Readable name shown in dropdowns across the portal.
help.pages.projects.field.platform: Primary UI test target: web (Playwright). Drives suite pass generation.
help.pages.projects.field.project_id: Stable ID in registry and reports. Lowercase, no spaces.
help.pages.projects.fields:
Project ID|Stable ID in registry and reports — do not rename after the first run
Label|Display name in the interface
Repository address|Code repository — latest code pulled each run
Base address|Default target for interface tests
help.pages.projects.steps:
Click Add project; fill project ID, label, repository address, and base address.
Use a lowercase project ID — it becomes the source ID in Test Catalog.
Delete only when no active runs depend on the project.
help.pages.projects.summary: Register and manage your applications here. Each project is defined by configuration.
help.pages.projects.title: Projects
help.pages.qualityMap.steps:
Select a project to scope the quality tree.
Review heatmap and explorer views for missing test coverage.
Use smart selection to run a scoped suite from entity keys.
Check release gate readiness before regression tiers.
help.pages.qualityMap.summary: Menu → screen → API quality tree, heatmaps, traceability, and release gate in one place.
help.pages.qualityMap.title: Quality map
help.pages.registry.field.source_id: Registry namespace — usually the same as project ID.
help.pages.registry.fields:
Source ID|Registry namespace
Test case ID|Stable test case identifier
Priority|P0 test cases may require approval before execution
Last run|Passed, failed, or queued
help.pages.registry.steps:
Select source ID — usually the same as project ID.
Check P0 test cases awaiting approval.
Approve selected — test jobs enter the queue.
Check last run status after the test run completes.
help.pages.registry.summary: Persistent NanobaseAI-generated test cases. P0 cases may need approval before execution.
help.pages.registry.title: Test Catalog
help.pages.reports.fields:
Text report|Full text with traceability matrix
PDF|Formatted executive report
help.pages.reports.steps:
Find the run by run ID.
Download the text report for traceability and developer handoff.
Download the PDF report for management review.
help.pages.reports.summary: Quick access to text and PDF reports from recent test runs.
help.pages.reports.title: Reports
help.pages.repos.field.clone_url: Code repository address to register in the system.
help.pages.repos.fields:
Repository address|Source code repository address
Repository ID|Auto-generated ID after registration
Code scan output|Text baseline from static analysis
help.pages.repos.steps:
Paste the repository address and save with clone.
Wait until the repository ID appears in the list.
View scan to read the code scan output.
Deep knowledge scan maps forms, database, and services.
Generate form tests to create form test flows.
Copy output to Spec vs Code Comparison if you have a custom specification.
help.pages.repos.summary: Source code registration and static analysis — pages, menus, and services become the baseline spec for spec vs code comparison.
help.pages.repos.title: Code Repositories
help.pages.results.steps:
Open Test runs to watch live progress, logs, and artifacts.
Open Reports for suite MD/PDF exports.
Open Analysis documents for scan-based operator summaries and downloads.
If the release banner is red, open the quality map or test status to see what to fix.
help.pages.results.summary: Track test runs, download MD/PDF reports, and review analysis documents from code scans.
help.pages.results.title: Results and evidence
help.pages.run.field.a11y_dedicated_pass: When enabled, accessibility runs as a separate pass instead of embedded in interface tests.
help.pages.run.field.auto_tier: Test scope is chosen automatically based on code changes, risk, and first-run status.
help.pages.run.field.browsers: Multiple browsers can be selected. Each browser runs as a separate job.
help.pages.run.field.enforce_parity: Stops the run when critical tests lack spec coverage or approval — fix missing coverage in Spec vs Code Comparison and Test Catalog first.
help.pages.run.field.force_regenerate: Ignore cache; regenerate all test cases.
help.pages.run.field.healing_enabled: On failure, applies self-healing fixes and retries once.
help.pages.run.field.include_a11y: Accessibility scan after each test; violations appear in job detail.
help.pages.run.field.include_api: Run backend service tests alongside interface tests.
help.pages.run.field.include_db: Run database structure checks (TC-DB) when a test database profile is configured; safely skipped otherwise.
help.pages.run.field.include_performance: Adds a separate performance pass. Measurement is quick or detailed depending on scope.
help.pages.run.field.include_visual: Page images are captured and compared to approved baselines.
help.pages.run.field.performance_mode: Automatic, quick, or detailed performance measurement.
help.pages.run.field.playwright_retries: Retries per test case. Higher values reduce flaky noise but lengthen runs.
help.pages.run.field.project: Must be registered in Projects. Sets repository address and defaults.
help.pages.run.field.tier: Quick, changed-only, wide, or full scope options.
help.pages.run.field.wait: Keeps this page blocked until the full run finishes (up to ~20 min). By default, live progress opens on the run detail screen.
help.pages.run.fields:
Project|Must exist in Projects registry
Test scope|Smoke, delta, regression, or full
Include API tests|Backend API tests alongside UI tests
Wait for completion|Wait until finished
Force regenerate|Regenerate all test cases
help.pages.run.steps:
Ensure environment is saved and health check passed.
Select project and test scope — smoke is recommended for the first run.
Enable API tests if frontend and backend should be tested together.
Start the QA test workflow — you are redirected to live test run detail.
Approve P0 test cases in Test Catalog if required.
help.pages.run.summary: Full QA test workflow: source sync, code scan, test case generation, automated execution, and report.
help.pages.run.title: Run Tests
help.pages.settings.field.api_key: Access key value from server configuration.
help.pages.settings.field.base_url: Leave empty when the portal is served from the same server.
help.pages.settings.field.brand_name: Organization or product name shown in the powered-by badge on module headers.
help.pages.settings.field.role: Access scope: admin full, QA runs and catalog, developer repository only.
help.pages.settings.field.slack_webhook: Messaging webhook URL for run completion summaries.
help.pages.settings.fields:
Server address|Empty = same origin; set for remote server
Access key|Keep secure, do not share
Access role|Admin, QA, manager, or developer
help.pages.settings.steps:
Get the access key from your administrator.
Paste it into the field and save configuration.
Test the connection to verify dashboard access.
Leave server address empty if the portal opens from the same server.
help.pages.settings.summary: Authentication settings between the portal and the test server.
help.pages.settings.title: Connection Settings
help.pages.setup.steps:
Register or select a project with the repository URL.
Configure the environment: site URL, login path, and test account.
Run the health check to confirm the test app is reachable.
Continue to the test process when both steps are green.
help.pages.setup.summary: Register your application and configure test URLs and credentials before scanning or running tests.
help.pages.setup.title: Project and environment setup
help.pages.suiteDetail.fields:
Test jobs|One job per test case
Text report|Traceability matrix and delta summary
PDF report|Executive summary for stakeholders
help.pages.suiteDetail.steps:
Check the overall status badge.
Download text or PDF report.
Note test case ID from failed jobs and search in Test Catalog.
Re-run with delta scope after fixing code.
help.pages.suiteDetail.summary: Single test run: job list, test case status, and report downloads. Updates until final result.
help.pages.suiteDetail.title: Run detail
help.pages.suites.fields:
Run ID|Unique run number
Status|Started, running, completed, or failed
Results|Passed and total job count
Scope|Quick, changed-only, wide, or full
help.pages.suites.steps:
Find run ID and status.
Open a run for per-job breakdown.
Download reports from run detail or the Reports page.
help.pages.suites.summary: All test runs. The list refreshes regularly while jobs are active.
help.pages.suites.title: Test Runs
help.pages.users.steps:
Create accounts for operators and developers.
Assign module access: BI reports and/or Test automation.
Set each user's preferred portal language.
Deactivate accounts instead of deleting when audit history must be kept.
help.pages.users.summary: Create accounts, assign modules (BI, Test), and set locale preferences.
help.pages.users.title: User management
help.pages.visualReview.steps:
Open a pending screenshot difference.
Approve if the change is intentional — it becomes the new baseline.
Reject to send the case back for triage.
Use the catalog or run links for more context.
help.pages.visualReview.summary: Approve or reject screenshot differences waiting after visual governance runs.
help.pages.visualReview.title: Visual review
help.pipeline.steps:
Projects — register your application
Environment Configuration — test URLs and credentials
Code Repositories — source sync and static code scan
Spec vs Code Comparison — compare specification with code baseline
Run Tests — generate test cases and execute automatically
Test Runs — track progress
Test Catalog — approve P0 test cases
Reports — download MD/PDF reports
help.whatToDo: What to do on this screen
settings.field.contracts_api_key: Optional. On portal.nanobase.ai leave empty — nginx injects CONTRACT_API_KEY. Only needed for direct :8795 access.
settings.field.contracts_base_url: URL of the Contract Intelligence API. Leave empty on portal.nanobase.ai to use /contracts-api.
